description_en: Obtains bandwidth data by carrier and region
description_zh: 调用DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService获取按运营商和地域获取带宽数据
name: DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据开始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The time range between the end time and the start time cannot exceed 1 hour
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间大于开始时间，并且结束时间和开始时间相差不超过1小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier. You can specify only one carrier at a time.

To query carrier names, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
运营商名，每次只能传入一个参数。

运营商名通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: isp_names

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region. Separate multiple region names with commas (,).

To query region names, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
地域名，多个地域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

地域名通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: location_names

JsonResult.description_en: The response in the JSON format. The data fields are returned in the following order: UNIX timestamp, region, carrier, distribution of HTTP status codes, response time, bandwidth in bps, average response rate, page views, cache hit ratio, and request hit ratio. ><notice>The hit rate is not calculated by region or carrier. A value of 0 is returned for the hit rate.></notice>
JsonResult.description_zh:
JSON格式的返回结果。
从左到右依次为：unix时间，地区，运营商，HTTP状态码分布，响应时长，带宽（单位：bps），响应平均速率，页面浏览量，缓存命中率，请求命中率。
<notice>地区、运营商维度不支持计算命中率，统一返回 0。></notice>
